property: Governed product edits need accepted intent; verified-delivery learning needs current intent/source-bound proof; recovery controls do not authorize product mutation.
limitations: The finite model covers a baseline plus at most two edits and two accepted intent versions, not arbitrary implementations or unbounded runs.

Progress assumes successful available tools, fair scheduling of review/verify/compound and the finite edit/amend bound; cancellation and permanent prerequisite failure are outside that progress claim.
Mode is a documented Engineer obligation, not a kernel-authenticated semantic task-mode variable. Actual conformance checks mutation/recovery authority.
CLI traces and one actual guard mutation establish observed correspondence and sensitivity, not complete implementation refinement.
The source inventory covers every regular file beneath the declared roots, including untracked writers; semantic completeness remains unverified.
